name: ClawAutoResearch
description: Multi-agent research workflow: ideation, experiment, analysis, paper, review.

allowWorkspaceFallback.description: Deprecated compatibility flag. Workflow project state and research memory no longer fall back to workspace-level paths; projects must resolve under projectsRoot.

requireProjectIsolation.description: Require OPENCLAW_PROJECT for research memory writes.

requireProjectIdInEntries.description: Require each structured memory entry to resolve to a project id.

requireTrackId.description: Require track ids for idea and experiment memory writes.

requireEvidencePointers.description: Require evidence pointers when writing structured research memory.

reviewStateMaxAgeHours.description: Maximum age of REVIEW_STATE.json before review resumability suggests a restart.

projectsRoot.description: Default root directory used by research_memory and workflow state when resolving project-level paths.

injectWorkflowContext.description: Inject a runtime workflow snapshot into each agent turn so roles, stages, blockers, and idle tasks stay visible.

enforceWorkflowBoundaries.description: Block out-of-scope writes, unsafe spawns, and disallowed inter-agent messaging based on workflow role policy.

blockDiscordAgentMentions.description: Sanitize raw @agent mentions in outbound Discord/chat messages and steer agents toward workflow-safe communication paths.

enableWorkflowMailbox.description: Enable the research_workflow mailbox tool for bounded internal handoffs and blocker notes.

heartbeatBackgroundChecks.description: On heartbeat/idling turns, inject bounded background-task guidance from the workflow state.

maxWorkflowInboxMessages.description: Maximum number of pending workflow mailbox items included in injected context or returned by default mailbox reads.

agentContactCooldownSeconds.description: Minimum cooldown between routing the same source agent to the same target agent through sessions_send, sessions_spawn, or workflow mailbox.

enableChannelProjectBindings.description: Allow Discord/session channels to bind to project roots so different channels can run different research projects in the same OpenClaw process.

channelProjectBindingsPath.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Channel-project bindings now always live at {projectRoot}/.openclaw-research/channel-project-bindings.json for projects under projectsRoot.

defaultConferenceTemplatePath.description: Optional default conference paper template path. When configured, conference writing mode copies this template into each project before Writer edits it.

defaultJournalTemplatePath.description: Optional default journal paper template path. When configured, journal writing mode copies this template into each project before Writer edits it.

papernexusApiBaseUrl.description: Optional remote PaperNexus Web/API base URL. When configured, workflow prompts steer graph-heavy tasks toward the remote PaperNexus service instead of assuming local-only access.

papernexusSharedCorpus.description: Optional plugin-wide shared PaperNexus corpus name. When configured, graph presence checks and workflow-owned repair/import passes prefer this shared corpus instead of falling back to project-scoped or internal default corpus names.

papernexusMcpUrl.description: Optional remote PaperNexus MCP endpoint URL. When papernexusAccessMode is remote_mcp, the workflow uses this HTTP MCP endpoint instead of spawning a local PaperNexus CLI.

papernexusMcpTransport.description: Remote PaperNexus MCP transport. The current workflow client supports streamable-http.

papernexusMcpTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for PaperNexus MCP requests. Applies to both local stdio MCP and remote HTTP MCP.

papernexusApiTokenEnv.description: Environment variable name that stores the PaperNexus API bearer token. The workflow will reference this env var name in prompts and never persist the raw token into project files.

papernexusApiTokenSource.description: How the workflow should resolve the PaperNexus API bearer token: from an environment variable, from the native OS keychain, or auto (env first, then OS keychain).

papernexusApiTokenService.description: Native keychain service/resource name used when PaperNexus API token resolution needs the OS credential store.

papernexusApiTokenAccount.description: Native keychain account/user name used when PaperNexus API token resolution needs the OS credential store.

papernexusApiTokenLookupTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for native OS keychain lookups when resolving the PaperNexus API bearer token.

papernexusMineruHttpUrl.description: Optional remote MinerU HTTP endpoint used by PaperNexus for PDF materialization. When configured, the workflow prefers this remote parser path before local Docling or Marker fallbacks.

papernexusAccessMode.description: How the workflow accesses PaperNexus graph operations. remote_api: HTTP bearer-token wrappers/Web API. remote_mcp: remote HTTP MCP endpoint. local_mcp: spawn local PaperNexus MCP server via stdio. auto: try remote API first, then remote MCP, then local MCP.

autoMode.description: Workflow auto-dispatch mode. conservative auto-launches stage owners but still stops at GATE-5; aggressive also uses auto gate review to progress submit to done.

enabled.description: Use the optional Lobster tool as the agent handoff backend for automatic workflow dispatches.

autoModeOnly.description: Only use Lobster handoff when workflow auto mode is active.

gatewayUrl.description: Gateway base URL used when invoking the optional Lobster tool from the research plugin.

pipelinePath.description: Optional absolute path to a custom Lobster workflow file. When empty, the bundled workflow-agent-dispatch.lobster is used.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout passed to the Lobster tool when running the workflow handoff pipeline.

maxStdoutBytes.description: Maximum stdout bytes allowed for the Lobster tool run.

fallbackToNative.description: If Lobster is unavailable or denied, fall back to the built-in native dispatch path instead of failing the workflow handoff.
